en.title: Cross-Regional Grapevine Cold Hardiness Prediction via Learned Multimodal Latent Representations
en.hook: High-precision daily cold hardiness prediction for woody plants using learned multimodal latent representations.
key_takeaways: Improves daily cold hardiness prediction accuracy for woody plants
Overrides limitations of traditional biophysical and hybrid models
Applies multimodal latent representations to agricultural climate resilience

克服传统生物物理和混合模型的局限性
应用多模态潜在表示应对农业气候挑战
